script: Players who got in trouble for the silliest reasons! It's game five of the 2022 NBA playoffs. The Miami Heat are trying to close out the Atlanta Hawks in the first round. And Jimmy Butler can't even play because he's sitting on the bench in street clothes nursing a knee injury. But what he does from that bench ends up costing him $15,000. With under two minutes left in the first half, Max Strus hits a huge three-pointer, and Butler jumps off the bench and starts doing this thrusting dance celebration on the sideline that the Heat's social media team loved so much they immediately posted a gif of it on their official account. Miami goes on to win 97 to 94 and clinch the entire series, so everything seems great. But two days later, the NBA sends Butler a $15,000 fine for making an obscene gesture from the bench area. The Heat organization also got hit with their own $15,000 fine for posting the clip on social media. So, a guy who wasn't even in uniform that night somehow cost his team a combined $30,000 by being too happy for his teammate. When reporters asked Butler about it in practice, he looked right at the camera and said, "It's Spo's fault. He always says to celebrate everybody else's success." Max goes on a 10-nothing run. I celebrate, I get fined.
